native.tour.welcome.title: Meet FM-1 Simulator
native.tour.welcome.body:
Play Sloop in your browser using its actual firmware interface. This tour points out the controls one step at a time.

You can close it anytime. To see it again, select the ? help icon beside the hamburger menu at the top right of this panel.
native.tour.layout.title: Choose your layout
native.tour.layout.body: Open ☰ → Layout to choose Device or Expanded. Device follows the FM-1 control arrangement. Expanded makes the screen larger while keeping the same controls.
native.tour.sound.title: Choose a sound
native.tour.sound.body:
From the home screen, ALGORITHM selects the track, PRESETS selects its sound, and SELECT sets tempo. MASTER adjusts browser volume.

The screen shows the current page and what each control does.
native.tour.knobs.title: Turn and fine tune
native.tour.knobs.body:
Drag a knob up or down. Hold Shift for slower, precise adjustments. You can also focus a knob and use the arrow keys or mouse wheel; Shift prevents firmware acceleration.

KNOB 1–4 follow the labels on the screen. Tap ENV or LFO to open their pages.
native.tour.keyboard.title: Play the keyboard
native.tour.keyboard.body:
Click, touch, or slide across the bottom keyboard. Enable typing and follow its QWERTY labels to play from your computer keyboard.

Firmware shortcuts use the central 27-key bank: 16 white keys counted from the starting F (F3 by default) through G two octaves above. Extra keys outside that bank play notes.
native.tour.layers.title: Tap pages, hold layers
native.tour.layers.body:
Tap a function button to open its pages. Hold FX, EDIT, ARP, SEQ, SCL, GLO or SAVE while using keys or knobs.

Hold a layer button and tap HOME to lock it; HOME or another layer releases it. FX plays effects, ARP rolls, SEQ edits steps, SCL selects the key, and GLO controls the mix. EDIT with OCT−/OCT+ undoes/redoes.
native.tour.record.title: Record a take
native.tour.record.body:
REC arms recording. Use the screen’s knob labels to choose free/tempo recording, length and note/count-in start. Play notes to record.

REC closes a free take; PLAY cancels it. Hold REC to clear the selected track. EDIT + OCT− restores it.
native.tour.song.title: Arrange sections
native.tour.song.body:
Hold SAVE: white keys 1–4 recall sections A–D; 5–8 store them (repeat to overwrite). White key 13 toggles song playback, 14 arms song recording, and 16 opens the song page.

Tapping SAVE opens the arranger from the track/drum pages, saves the arrangement on the song page, or opens SAVE pages elsewhere.
native.tour.finish.title: Ready to play
native.tour.finish.body:
Hold HOME for settings. In menus, PRESETS moves, KNOB 1 changes values, OCT+ confirms and OCT− returns. Browser sessions autosave projects, presets, song order and settings.

USB audio input and hardware calibration need a physical FM-1. External MIDI keyboard input is not yet wired into the browser synth.

Replay this tour anytime with the ? icon beside the ☰ menu.
